verdict.rationale: llamafile is a single self-contained executable that needs no installation. A documented `--cli` mode answers whatever prompt you pass it, and a `--server` mode exposes an HTTP API, so it can be scripted headlessly in automation pipelines. It also runs fully offline across many operating systems, which makes it easy to drop into runners. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline usage documentation or examples (exit codes, batch/non-interactive output formats), independent hands-on reports of CI use, and a fix for the Windows 4GB executable limit that constrains portable runners.
